Choice A (Save the wounded soldiers at the cost of jettisoning the laudanum crate): The soldiers survive; in Act 4, npc-rowan-commander in town-ironcamp has 2 extra veteran guards and reduces mercenary hiring costs by -20%, though npc-sera-healer's healing services in Act 3 cost +25% more. Choice B (Abandon the back litter of dying men to save the heavy medicine chest): Sera's shop prices drop by -20% in town-oakhaven, but her greeting turns cold ('We saved the bottles, didn't we?') and 2 hollow-knight enemies appear in m30-starved-bastion.

A covered cart packed with clean linen, bone-saws, and willow-bark broke an axle on the coastal road while raiders closed in. Sera refuses to abandon the supplies when her infirmary tents are already overflowing.

title: The Mountain Convoy
summary: Act III side quest from Shipwright Kors in Oakhaven, awarding gold and experience for securing highland timber deliveries.

p: Kors cannot brace the harbor boom-chains without heartwood beams of mountain ironbark, and the timber sledges from the high pass are three days overdue. Frosthorn Bruisers have rolled boulders across the switchbacks and are using the logging sledges for firewood. Escort the surviving timber-wright and his two ox-sledges down the pass to the shipyard gates.

Choice A (Deliver all the ironbark timber to npc-kors-shipwright for the harbor boom): The harbor chains hold in m35-burning-harbor, reducing enemy redglass-drake spawns by 1, and Kors upgrades your shields. Choice B (Divert half the timber to npc-lyra-warden to shore up the town's bell-tower barricades): Lyra pays +200 gold and gives you extra traps in m30-starved-bastion, but Kors refuses to speak to you and m35-burning-harbor has 2 extra ash-weaver enemies boarding from the sea.

You cannot lay a caravel keel out of rotten driftwood, and Kors needs seasoned ironwood beams hauled down from the upper ridge. Clearing the ambushes along the logging grade keeps the slipways hammering.

title: The Bell-Tower Picket
summary: Act III side quest from Warden Lyra in Oakhaven, rewarding gold and experience for reclaiming a coastal lookout tower.

p: Three floating Frost Bells have drifted down from the highland rifts and anchored themselves in the sea-fog around the old watchtower at the riverlock. Every time the tide turns, their sub-audible tolling cracks the mortar of the floodgates and freezes the sentries' fingers to their crossbows. Shatter all three astral bells before the lock-gates burst.

Choice A (Melt the bronze shards down for npc-lyra-warden's watchmen): Lyra outfits her pickets with cold-forged bolts; in m34-clashing-banners, allied archers assist you at the flank. Choice B (Leave one cracked bell hanging at the riverlock as a resonant ward against flyers): It keeps rift-moth enemies out of m31-riverlock-crossing, but the constant freezing chime drives two of Lyra's sentries mad, increasing town guard bribe/toll costs by +15%.
With fog rolling thick off the Western Sea, a blind harbor is a dead harbor. Lyra needs the high bell-tower swept clear of hostile scouts so her watchmen can spot approaching sails and fires.

title: Low-Tide Salvage
summary: Act III side quest from Mudlark Pip in Oakhaven, offering gold and experience for looting wrecks before the tide turns.

p: When the neap tide pulls back from the sunken citadel causeway, the mudflats glint with pay-chests dropped during the first evacuation. Pip knows where the paymaster's iron strongboxes sank, but a colony of armored Salt Crabs has crusted over the wrecks like living reefs. Collect five barnacle-welded strongboxes from the flats before the tide and the crabs close in.

Choice A (Split the salvaged military payroll 50/50 with npc-pip-mudlark as promised): Pip opens his black-market curio stash in town-oakhaven at -25% discount and tips you off about a hidden chest in m32-elder-juggernaut. Choice B (Confiscate the strongboxes in the name of the garrison and hand them to npc-lyra-warden): You receive a 300 gold commendation from Lyra, but Pip vanishes from town-oakhaven permanently, locking out his fence shop.

Pip knows every broken hull wedged along the shingle flats, though he prefers letting someone in iron armor deal with the salt crabs. Grab the brass fittings while the mud is exposed, or swim for them.

title: Silencing the Orchard
summary: Act III side quest from Healer Sera in Oakhaven, granting gold and experience for culling blighted coastal trees.

p: Above the starved bastion lies a terraced apple grove that drank too much ash and unburied blood; now its trunks walk as Night Orchards, hanging human skulls from their boughs like winter fruit. The soldiers on the ramparts hear the skulls chattering their dead brothers' names through the fog. Cut down the two eldest orchard-trees so the garrison can sleep.

Choice A (Burn the skull-fruit in quicklime as npc-sera-healer asks): Garrison morale steadies, giving your party +10 mind in m33-high-stakes-gambit. Choice B (Harvest the glowing skull-lanterns for Act 4 siege illumination): In Act 4, npc-vok-forgemaster in town-ironcamp buys them for +450 gold to light his slag-tunnels, but npc-sera-healer refuses to speak anything but a single disgusted line for the rest of Act 3.

Blighted cider trees along the upper terrace have begun dropping toxic spores straight into the town's rain-barrels. Sera needs axes and fire taken to the twisted grove before the harbor garrison falls sick.

title: Pitch for the Fire-Ships
summary: Act III side quest from Shipwright Kors in Oakhaven, paying gold and experience for securing barrels of naval pitch.

p: To stop the dread-fleet from landing at the harbor mole, Kors is packing three leaky coastal cogs with oil-soaked cordage and sulfur to ram the vanguard. Ash Weavers have already infiltrated the drydocks, spinning flame-threads across the rigging to detonate the hulls prematurely. Reach the three fire-ships moored along the outer jetty and cut the burning webs.

Choice A (Launch the fire-ships early into the narrow channel): They sink the enemy vanguard barge, removing 2 doom-knight enemies from m35-burning-harbor, but the burning oil slick destroys Kors's lower boathouse, raising his repair costs by +20%. Choice B (Hold the fire-ships until the merchant barges clear the mole): The merchants reward you with +350 gold in Act 4 at town-ironcamp, but 1 extra cinderhorn lands on the docks in m35-burning-harbor.

Old hulks packed with tar and dry oakum are the cheapest way to break a hostile blockade at the harbor mouth. Kors needs every intact cask hauled out of the contested coastal yards before raiders torch them.

title: Iron on the Wall
summary: Act IV side quest from Commander Rowan in Ironcamp, awarding gold and experience for reinforcing battered ramparts.

p: The outer curtain wall is buckling under the siege-breakers, and a vanguard of Dread Knights has planted black iron banners on the east parapet to guide the hell-mortars. Rowan needs someone to walk the broken battlements and hurl those knights into the ditch before the mortar-crews zero in on the command tent. Slay five Dread Knights holding the eastern wall-walk.

Choice A (Use the captured black iron banners to reinforce the breach-gates): m42-outer-rampart starts with reinforced gates (+30% barricade durability), and npc-rowan-commander grants access to his elite reserve armory. Choice B (stake the Dread Knights' armor along the glacis as a grim warning): It provokes the hell-vanguard; m41-gauntlet-of-iron spawns 2 extra doom-knight champions, but each drops guaranteed high-tier rune-iron (+400 gold value).
Greystone's curtain wall has taken enough basalt boulders to rattle every tooth in the garrison. Rowan needs heavy iron tie-plates carried up to the breach before the next Iron Pact cohort arrives.

title: The Unquenched Jaw
summary: Act IV side quest from Forgemaster Vok in Ironcamp, rewarding gold and experience for hunting a fiery foundry threat.

p: Vok's great steam-trip hammer cracked its bedplate, and no terrestrial iron can take the heat of the ember-steel he needs to forge for the final push. Only the living anvil-jaw of an Anvilmaw Smith from the cinder-trenches stays hard at white heat. Hunt down two of the forge-titans beyond the shattered beacons and drag their lower jaws back on chains.

Choice A (Bolt the demon jaws directly into Vok's town forge): npc-vok-forgemaster reduces all weapon and armor crafting/upgrade prices by -25% in town-ironcamp, though the cursed soot gives your hero -5 cold_res. Choice B (Quench the jaws in holy salt before mounting them, as npc-elias-penitent begs): The metal loses half its heat-temper (no shop discount from Vok, who calls you a superstitious fool), but npc-elias-penitent blesses your party with +15 fire_res for the rest of Act 4.

Something big and red-hot has been nesting inside the abandoned slag-pit, chewing through Vok's best ironstone ore. Clear out the beast so the foundrymen can relight the main bellows without losing an arm.

title: The Burnt Syllabus
summary: Act IV side quest from Penitent Elias in Ironcamp, offering gold and experience for recovering charred arcane texts.

p: Before Elias took the penitent's chains, he was tutor to the young nobles of the Ember Court—and it was his syllabus of pyromantic theorems that taught the court to open the cinder-gates. Four lead-bound cylinders containing his original lecture notes are still locked in the ruined scriptorium along the gauntlet. Collect the four cylinders so he can burn his life's work in clean fire.

Choice A (Let npc-elias-penitent melt the cylinders in the brazier): Elias finds peace, his dialogue changes to quiet resolve, and he permanently grants your party +8 mind and +10 mana_regen. Choice B (Keep the pyromantic theorems and sell them to npc-vok-forgemaster to superheat his blast furnaces): Vok pays +600 gold and adds fire-damage affixes to his shop stock, but Elias hangs himself in his cell before m44-threshold-choice, removing his NPC services from town-ironcamp.

Even heretical Collegium notes contain useful warnings when you are marching straight into a volcanic sanctuary. Elias wants the half-burned folios gathered from the ash-drifts before the wind scatters them.

title: Thunder on the Glacis
summary: Act IV side quest from Commander Rowan in Ironcamp, granting gold and experience for silencing enemy bombardment.

p: Two ancient Stormtrees have rooted themselves in the mud of the three-roads siege works, acting as living lightning-rods that fry Rowan's catapult crews whenever the ash-clouds rub together. The engineers have rigged copper earthing-spikes, but someone has to defend the sappers while they drive the chains into the roots. Defend the sapper team at the outer rampart.

Choice A (Ground the lightning harmlessly into the bedrock): The catapults survive, bombarding m43-three-roads-siege and removing 2 basalt-brute enemies from the map. Choice B (Channel the Stormtrees' charge into the camp's iron Palisade): Any melee enemy striking the gates in m43-three-roads-siege takes lightning damage, but the surge kills three sappers and npc-rowan-commander deducts 300 gold in blood-compensation.
Hostile siege engines dug in along the outer slope are chewing up the approach road day and night. Rowan pays well for a quick raid that spikes the barrels and scatters the crews.

title: Slag-Trench Convoy
summary: Act IV side quest from Forgemaster Vok in Ironcamp, paying gold and experience for escorting ore through volcanic flats.

p: The forward battery at the three roads has burned through its last barrel of quenched ballista-bolts, and Cinderhorns are prowling the ash-dunes between the camp and the battery. Vok has loaded an iron-plated powder dray drawn by blind quarry-oxen, and no regular teamster will touch the reins. Escort the iron dray across the siege lines to the battery.

Choice A (Deliver the bolts to the forward battery as ordered): The ballistae pin down aerial threats, removing 2 redglass-drake enemies in m45-crown-of-order. Choice B (Detonate the powder dray inside the Cinderhorn breeding pit along the route): It wipes out all cinderhorn spawns in m44-threshold-choice, but npc-vok-forgemaster is furious over his lost iron dray and increases his repair fees by +30%.
Meteoric iron does not walk itself up to the anvil, and the mule trains hauling billets across the slag trenches keep losing guards. Keep the carts rolling so Highcrest's smiths never run dry.

title: The Choir in the Nave
summary: Act IV side quest from Penitent Elias in Ironcamp, awarding top gold and experience for quieting a haunted inner hall.

p: In the sunken basilica beneath the threshold, the prelate-abomination Vesperion conducts a choir of hollow pipes carved from the collarbones of the first penitents. Every hymn it exhales drains the warmth from the living and turns camp sentries into sleepwalking husks. Enter the basilica before the final reckoning and silence Vesperion, the Hollow Choir.

Choice A (Shatter Vesperion's bone pipe-organ completely): The trapped souls disperse; in m46-ember-reckoning, boss ashkarath loses his spectral choir shield phase, making the final fight direct. Choice B (Bind the organ's main bone-pipe into your own standard as a war-horn): Your party gains +15% lifesteal and terrorizes lesser enemies in m46-ember-reckoning, but npc-rowan-commander and npc-elias-penitent refuse to stand near you in town-ironcamp, calling you the new Prelate of Ash.

A cold, rhythmic droning echoes up from a collapsed subterranean nave near the Threshold, rattling the nerves of every sentry on watch. Elias asks for steel and resolve to lay the restless chorus to rest.

title: Iron in the Weir
summary: Act I side quest from Ferryman Fenwick in Thornwick, rewarding gold and experience for salvaging iron from river weirs.

p: Old Fenwick's wicker eel-traps below the Sunken Ford have been torn apart by Bog Leeches bloated on gnoll carrion. Worse, one trap snagged a waterproofed courier-tube stamped with the Border Mint's wax. Clear the leeches out of the weir stakes and pull up the cylinder before the river-rot eats the parchment.

Choice A (flag_fenwick_mint_returned: Deliver the sealed courier-tube to npc-garrick-captain): Garrick rewards you with +80 gold and unlocks +1 militia archer in m08-alder-bridge. Choice B (flag_fenwick_mint_fence: Let npc-fenwick-ferryman sell the wax dies to river smugglers): You pocket +160 gold immediately, but Fenwick's river-salvage prices rise by +15%.
When gnolls tore apart the willow eel-traps down at the bend, half a dozen good iron chains went straight into the mud. Fenwick wants them dragged back before the current buries them for good.

title: Cold Hearth Coal
summary: Act I side quest from Smith Hobb in Thornwick, paying gold and experience for hauling fresh coal to the town forge.

p: Thornwick's smithy is down to damp birch charcoal that spits sparks and leaves iron brittle as glass. Two abandoned anthracite barrows sit just outside the Ravenwatch ditch, currently overrun by Bone Gnawers chewing the leather harness-straps. Haul four sacks of dry sea-coal back to Hobb's forge.
Wet alder wood makes plenty of smoke and almost no heat, which is useless for hammering out pike-heads. Hobb needs dry charcoal sacks recovered from the abandoned timber camps before his fire dies.

title: Rue for the Grey Itch
summary: Act I side quest from Alchemist Marta in Thornwick, offering gold and experience for gathering medicinal border herbs.

p: Half the pickets returning from the Sunken Sanctum are scratching their wrists raw with grey water-blisters. Widow Marta needs bitter marsh-rue growing along the flooded causeway steps, guarded by Drowned Thralls that rise whenever ripples touch the stone. Gather five bundles of marsh-rue before the rash reaches the archers' bow-hands.
Standing knee-deep in cold river muck gives half the garrison a blistering rash that ruins a soldier's grip. Marta needs fresh bitter rue clipped from the dry bluffs to boil down a proper salve.

title: The Broken Axle
summary: Act I side quest from Captain Garrick in Thornwick, awarding gold and experience for salvaging a wrecked supply cart.

p: A two-wheeled ammunition wain carrying three hundred ash-shaft quarrels threw its iron rim half a mile east of the Greywood fork. Garrick has two sappers jacking up the axle under cover of brambles while Briar Hounds circle the scent of tallow. Defend the wain until the wheel is wedged and rolled clear.

Choice A (flag_alder_bolts_garrison: Deliver all three hundred quarrels to npc-garrick-captain): Garrison crossbowmen gain +15% volley damage during m08-alder-bridge and m11-ashbrook-retreat. Choice B (flag_alder_bolts_sold: Sell half the crate to private caravan guards before reporting in): You gain +140 gold immediately, but Garrick docks your next ration issue (-10% starting stamina in m08-alder-bridge).
A loaded ration wagon snapped its rear beam half a mile south of the palisade, spilling oats and iron nails into the ditch. Garrick wants the freight hauled back before briar-hounds claim it.

title: Salt-Crust Beacons
summary: Act II side quest from Warden Hale in Redmarsh, rewarding gold and experience for relighting desert trail markers.

p: Alkali fog rolls across the Redmarsh flats every dusk, blinding supply columns straying off the stone causeway. Warden Hale's signal-braziers along the northern salt-pans have been toppled by Alkali Stalkers nesting in the dry reeds. Reach the three fallen tripod beacons and relight their oil-pans.
Alkali fog turns the salt-pans into a white blindfold where a patrol can walk in circles until its water runs out. Hale needs the oil-pots along the outer ridge scraped clean and lit again.

title: Jawbone Wind-Chimes
summary: Act II side quest from Scholar Zahra in Redmarsh, paying gold and experience for studying bone wards on the flats.

p: Desert raiders have strung hollowed femur-flutes across the Twin Passes that shriek whenever gusts blow north, panicking pack-mules and masking ambush horns. Zahra believes the bone-carvings preserve pre-dynastic wind-wards worth studying. Clear the Sand-Clan Skirmishers guarding the ridge ledges and bring down the bone-chimes.

Choice A (flag_jawbone_chimes_zahra: Give the intact bone-flutes to npc-zahra-scholar): Zahra decodes the wind-cadence, granting your party +10% movement speed across Redmarsh missions (m14–m23). Choice B (flag_jawbone_chimes_smashed: Smash the cursed flutes on the rocks to quiet the pass immediately): Mules travel calmer (+120 gold caravan bonus), but Zahra calls it an act of vandalism.
Desert hexers string bleached animal jaws across canyon mouths to rattle warnings whenever patrols pass beneath. Zahra wants several intact chimes collected so she can trace their resonant markings.

title: Brine-Barrel Reckoning
summary: Act II side quest from Water-Seller Tull in Redmarsh, offering gold and experience for recovering stolen water casks.

p: Three iron-hooped casks of distilled sweet-water fell off a panicked pack-lizard in Bracken Basin during the dust storm. Cask-Master Tull can smell clean water a league away—and so can the Dune Lurkers burrowing beneath the thorn-scrub. Recover the three brass-spigoted barrels before their staves split in the sun.
Raiders slipped past the lower stilts at night and rolled four iron-hooped barrels straight into the reeds. Tull does not care how many bandits you drop, so long as the staves come back unsplit.

title: Vinegar for Highgate
summary: Act II side quest from Quartermaster Bram in Redmarsh, awarding gold and experience for delivering sour brine-purifiers.

p: After the firepot assault on Highgate Watch, the garrison is out of sour-wine vinegar to cool blistered shields and scrub pitch off timber. Bram hired a one-eyed drover to haul four carboys from the old border cellar, but the cart is stuck near a nest of Claw Vipers. Escort the vinegar cart safely to the outpost gate.

Highgate's cisterns are growing green scum in the noon heat, and plain boiled water no longer sits right in the gut. Bram needs jugs of sharp vinegar run up the trail before dysentery empties the wall.

title: Quartz-Splinter Harvest
summary: Act II side quest from Alchemist Marta in Redmarsh, rewarding gold and experience for collecting charged crystal chips.

p: The ruptured plateau wardstones shed finger-length slivers of charged quartz that hold lightning better than copper wire. Widow Marta wants six uncracked splinters to brew static-salve for the vanguard's boots, though Ash-Wraiths drawn to the residual hum prowl the scree. Slay the wraiths haunting the plateau rim.
Following the army south taught Marta that desert quartz holds a far cleaner spark than northern slag. She pays well for hand-sized splinters knocked loose around the humming plateau spires.

title: Pit-Prop Timbers
summary: Act II side quest from Miner Tomas in Redmarsh, paying gold and experience for securing heavy quarry support beams.

p: Since the slave-revolt in the Deep Quarry, two lower galleries groan under unsupported basalt ceilings where thirty rescued miners left their tools and dead kin. Miner Tomas needs heavy cedar pit-props wedged beneath the main fault arch before the roof caves in. Defend the timber-crews while they brace the gallery.

Choice A (flag_quarry_gallery_braced: Hold the gallery until the miners recover their dead and iron tools): Tomas gifts you +15% physical damage for pioneer/melee units in m23-fork-of-spears. Choice B (flag_quarry_gallery_collapsed: Collapse the tunnel early to bury pursuing Pale Burrowers): You finish with zero casualties and +150 gold in salvaged ore, but Tomas mourns the unburied dead.
The third basalt terrace groans every time a heavy cart rolls past, and half the old cedar props are split by dry rot. Tomas needs sound timbers hauled down before the gallery seals itself.

title: The Four-Faced Milestone
summary: Act II side quest from Warden Hale in Redmarsh, granting gold and experience for inspecting the Four-Faced Milestone.

p: Raider outriders chipped the distance glyphs off Crossroads Redoubt's milestone and planted false trail-cairns leading supply trains into alkali sinkholes. Warden Hale needs a mounted picket to ride the four approaches and topple the decoy cairns before the baggage column marches at dawn. Destroy the four decoy rock-cairns along the desert tracks.
Two couriers took the eastern fork last week and vanished without a trace. Hale suspects someone tampered with the old crossroads obelisk and wants a sharp pair of eyes on its carved faces.

title: Caulking Oakum
summary: Act III side quest from Shipwright Kors in Oakhaven, rewarding gold and experience for gathering hemp hull-caulking.

p: Kors's shipwrights have green pine planks aplenty, but zero tarred hemp oakum to seal the seams of the troop barges. Three wrecked merchant cogs grounded on the Greywash mudflats still hold dry bales of hemp cordage in their forecastles, guarded by Mire Crocs. Collect four bales of dry hemp oakum from the mudflat wrecks.
A seaworthy hull leaks like a basket without miles of tarred hemp driven tight between every plank. Kors needs dry oakum bales recovered from the overrun rope-walks along the cliff road.

title: Fumarole Glass
summary: Act III side quest from Healer Sera in Oakhaven, paying gold and experience for harvesting clean volcanic glass.

p: Where the Cinder Wards boiled the cliffside groundwater, the heat fused beach sand into thin sheets of sterile volcanic glass—ideal for lancing boils and suturing deep shrapnel wounds without rust fever. Chief Healer Sera needs four unshattered panes from the cooling vents, now prowled by Cinder-Hounds. Slay the hounds nesting among the fumaroles.
When steel scalpels dull and rust in the coastal salt air, freshly fractured fumarole glass cuts cleaner than any guild blade. Sera needs unchipped pieces gathered from the smoking vents inland.

title: Semaphore Codebooks
summary: Act III side quest from Warden Lyra in Oakhaven, awarding gold and experience for recovering lost coastal signal books.

p: When Sundered Ranks fell, a signal-corporal bolted down the sea-cliffs with the iron-bound cipher tables used by coastal watchtowers. If those tables reach Admiral Kael's fleet, every lighthouse beacon between Oakhaven and the straits becomes an enemy guidepost. Track the deserter's trail and eliminate the Coastal Privateers escorting him.

Choice A (flag_semaphore_burned: Burn the cipher tables on the cliff as npc-lyra-warden ordered): Enemy naval bombardment accuracy drops by 20% in m35-burning-harbor. Choice B (flag_semaphore_kept: Keep the cipher tables to decode enemy supply signals): You gain +220 gold from intercepted smugglers, but Korvus's pier batteries target your flank more accurately in m35-burning-harbor.

If blockade captains learn Harborwatch's flag-codes, they can lure incoming transports straight onto the shingle reefs. Lyra needs the missing signal slates pulled from fallen watch-posts immediately.

title: Undertow Chains
summary: Act III side quest from the Harbor Pilot in Oakhaven, offering gold and experience for clearing fouled boom-chains.

p: Even with the Sunken Citadel's sea-gates wedged shut, submerged harbor-chains stretched across the outer channel threaten to rip the keels off Oakhaven's troop transports at low water. The harbor pilot needs sappers protected on the barnacle-slick reef while they file through three anchor-shackles. Reach the three submerged chain-winches before the tide floods back.
Heavy iron harbor chains are tangled with wreck-timber and crawling with armored sea-beasts at the cove mouth. Freeing the links lets the evacuation ships slip out on the evening tide.

title: Tallow for the Mill-Wheel
summary: Act III side quest from Mudlark Pip in Oakhaven, rewarding gold and experience for delivering tallow to coastal mills.

p: With the Twin Riverlocks jammed, Oakhaven's tidal grain-mill can finally grind hardtack for the fleet—except the main wooden axle is bone-dry and smoking like a tinderbox. Mudlark Pip spotted two casks of rendered whale-tallow left behind in a smugglers' cove guarded by Bog Lurkers. Escort Pip's handcart back from the cove without spilling the casks.
Dry wooden gears scream loud enough to draw raiders from a mile away and snap teeth when grinding emergency flour. Pip pays handsomely for tubs of clean mutton tallow hauled to the mill-house.

title: Lodestone Compasses
summary: Act III side quest from the Harbor Pilot in Oakhaven, paying gold and experience for retrieving magnetized ship needles.

p: Near the fallen Elder Juggernaut on the pine ridge, magnetic ore veins spin iron compass needles in circles—a fatal hazard once the fleet enters the volcanic fog of the southern straits. The harbor pilot needs four fist-sized chunks of natural lodestone to re-magnetize the ships' binnacles. Collect four magnetic lodestone nodules from the shattered ridge.

Sailing west into zero-visibility ash-fog without a true needle is just a slow way to drown. The pilot needs intact lodestone compasses salvaged from wrecked coastal cutters before the fleet weighs anchor.

title: The Baron's Cellar Keys
summary: Act III side quest from Mudlark Pip in Oakhaven, granting gold and experience for finding keys to Baron Vane's vaults.

p: Baron Vane's tax-bailiffs locked forty barrels of salted herring and twelve crates of crossbow strings inside his flooded sea-cellar before fleeing the keep. Tide-Ghouls drawn to the brine have nested behind the iron grate. Clear the ghouls out of the lower vault so Oakhaven's dockworkers can haul out the provisions.

Choice A (flag_baron_cellar_town: Distribute the salted herring to Oakhaven's dockworkers): Dockworkers volunteer to crew the fire-brigades in m35-burning-harbor (+15% pier durability). Choice B (flag_baron_cellar_sold: Sell the preserved rations to privateer captains in the bay): You pocket +300 gold immediately, but Oakhaven's dockworkers jeer your vanguard.

Everyone on the docks knows Baron Vane hoarded salted beef and lamp oil behind thick oak doors while refugees starved. Pip has a plan to redistribute the cellar, provided someone lifts the iron keys first.

title: Yellow Crust Markers
summary: Act IV side quest from the Ash-Scout in Ironcamp, rewarding gold and experience for staking safe highland trails.

p: Two supply teams already lost mules to boiling sulfur sinkholes between the landing coves and Highcrest bluff. Ash-Scouts have forged iron warning-stakes tipped with white chalk, but Ash-Stalkers keep ambushing anyone who strays off the basalt ridge. Reach the four thin-crust fissures and drive in the warning-stakes.

Yellow sulfur crusts look solid until a horse's hoof punches straight through into a boiling steam-pocket. Driving iron marker-stakes along the firm basalt ridges saves the next column from a grim surprise.

title: Prism Dust for the Anvil
summary: Act IV side quest from Forgemaster Vok in Ironcamp, paying gold and experience for gathering crushed beacon crystal.

p: Shattering the Obsidian Beacons left behind heaps of vitrified prism-sand that turns ordinary quenched steel blue-hard when sprinkled into the crucible. Vok needs five pouches of ground prism-sand before his apprentices can re-edge the vanguard's halberds, though Spark Elementals still crackle around the ruins. Collect five pouches of prism-sand from the beacon crags.

Sprinkling fine crystal dust onto white-hot meteoric iron draws out impurities that ordinary charcoal flux cannot touch. Vok wants sacks of ground prism shards swept up from the shattered highland towers.

title: Pumice Mortar
summary: Act IV side quest from the Siege Sapper in Ironcamp, awarding gold and experience for hauling volcanic mortar.

p: Greystone Bastion's east wall survived the demonic catapults, but its mortar joints are cracked from parapet to footing. Siege sappers are mixing pulverized volcanic pumice with hot brine to seal the fractures before ash-squalls erode the stone. Defend the mason-sappers on the outer ledge from prowling Slag Fiends.

Choice A (flag_greystone_mortar_cured: Hold the ledge until the pumice mortar cures completely): Greystone's garrison reinforces your rear guard, granting +10% armor to infantry in m41-gauntlet-of-iron. Choice B (flag_greystone_mortar_rushed: Pull the sappers back early to salvage their bronze mixing-cauldrons): You gain +280 gold in salvaged bronze, but Greystone's east wall remains fragile.
Ordinary lime cracks the first time a caldera tremor shakes the parapet, whereas pumice mortar bends and holds. Bringing fresh barrels up to the sappers keeps the forward redoubt standing.

title: Ashveil Cleft-Wardens
summary: Act IV side quest from Penitent Elias in Ironcamp, offering gold and experience for clearing hostile sentinels.

p: When Arch-Mage Malrik fell in Ashveil Gorge, three of his bound Shadow Constructs remained anchored to obsidian monoliths in the side clefts, attacking every dispatch rider carrying wounded back to Ironcamp. Brother Elias knows the counter-sigils to unbind them cleanly. Destroy the three Shadow Constructs haunting the gorge.
Silent armored figures have been blocking the narrow ash-drifts of the gorge, turning back supply runners without a word. Elias asks for a disciplined push to open the cleft.

title: Magnetic Vein Spikes
summary: Act IV side quest from Commander Rowan in Ironcamp, granting gold and experience for grounding lodestone cliffs.

p: The raw iron cliffs of the Gauntlet tug heavy plate armor sideways and deflect crossbow bolts mid-flight. Captain Rowan's sappers forged copper-sheathed grounding spikes to bleed off the canyon's magnetic pull before the supply train marches through. Escort the sapper-cart through the cleared checkpoint gates while they hammer in the spikes.

Choice A (flag_gauntlet_grounded: Ground the entire canyon wall cleanly): Ranged accuracy across Act 4 missions (m42–m46) increases by +15%. Choice B (flag_gauntlet_overloaded: Overload the spikes to shatter the cliffside iron veins for Vok's forge): You gain +350 gold in raw magnetic ore, but falling rock injures two sappers.
Driving heavy copper spikes into the magnetic rock faces bleeds off the pull that yanks iron weapons out of soldiers' hands. Rowan needs a squad to hammer them home under sniper fire.

title: Ashes of the First Watch
summary: Act IV side quest from Penitent Elias in Ironcamp, paying high gold and experience for recovering ancient watch relics.

p: Scattered along the obsidian stair below the Threshold Chamber lie the charred brass name-plates of the original First Watch wardens who died sealing the caldera centuries ago. Elias wishes to recover five intact name-plates so their oaths are formally witnessed before the final door opens. Collect five charred brass warden-plates from the obsidian stair.

Scattered across the caldera approaches lie iron urns belonging to the forgotten sentinels who first guarded the Threshold. Elias believes returning their ashes to consecrated stone will steady the vanguard's nerve.

title: The Rusted Toll-Chain
summary: Act I frontier side quest from the Ford Tollkeeper, rewarding gold and experience for clearing a jammed river chain.

p: Gnoll raiders dragged the heavy iron ferry-chain into the shallows below the Old Border Mint, halving river crossings. Haul the chain links back before high water.

list: Clear the Briar Hounds scavenging near loc-border-mint-ruin
Recover 3 Heavy Toll-Chain Links from the river mud
Return the chain links to Clerk Oswin

p: The heavy iron chain stretched across the Alder shallows rusted solid after the last raid, blocking friendly boats while letting raiders wade right over it. Someone needs to break the padlock and clear the bank.

title: Sunken Peat-Spades
summary: Act I frontier side quest from the Fen Peat-Cutter, paying gold and experience for retrieving lost bog tools.

p: Bog-gas flares drove Mara's cutters from the southern hollow, leaving five iron-shod spades behind. Extinguish the Mire Wisps and retrieve the tools.

list: Disperse 6 Mire Wisps in loc-willow-sink
Collect 5 Iron-Shod Peat Spades

p: Good iron-shod turf spades are impossible to replace since the Salt Tithe emptied the smithies. The cutters dropped their whole rack in the reeds when mire wisps chased them off the boardwalk.

title: Mildewed Muster-Rolls
summary: Act I frontier side quest from Captain Garrick, offering gold and experience for recovering mildewed muster rolls.

p: Ruin Mites are chewing through the old levy-rolls stored in Ravenwatch's guard-cellar. Exterminate the nest and save the surviving muster ledgers.

list: Slay 10 Ruin Mites inside loc-ravenwatch-cellar
Recover 4 Vellum Muster-Rolls
Deliver the rolls to Captain Garrick

p: Without the old cellar muster-books, Thornwick's bailiffs cannot tell which levies deserted and which ones died holding the fords. Garrick wants the damp rolls pulled out of the ruined watch-house.

title: Tallow for the Third Post
summary: Act I frontier side quest from the Ashbrook Watchman, awarding gold and experience for delivering lamp tallow.

p: The limestone beacon along Lantern Passage burned dry after Cinder Shamans fouled its oil-cistern. Carry fresh tallow-casks up the switchback and relight the cage.

list: Eliminate the Cinder Shaman near loc-hermit-lamp-post
Refill and ignite the Third Lantern Post

p: The third lantern-post along the foggy pass has been burning down to bare wick for two nights straight. Hauling a fresh tub of mutton tallow through the mist keeps the road from going completely blind.

title: Teeth of the Greywood Mill
summary: Act I frontier side quest from the Greywood Sawyer, rewarding gold and experience for reclaiming stolen saw blades.

p: Thorn Boars rooted up the timber yard outside Greywood Water-Mill, scattering Dobb's tempered crosscut blades. Drive off the beasts and gather the steel.

list: Kill 5 Thorn Boars around loc-greywood-sawmill
Retrieve 3 Tempered Crosscut Blades

p: Two-man steel crosscut saws take a master smith a week to tooth, and raiders carried off the mill's last three blades. Without them, Thornwick cannot cut fresh palisade logs before winter.

title: Pitch for the Craghorn Cairns
summary: Act I frontier side quest from the Ravenwatch Runner, paying gold and experience for supplying ridge signal cairns.

p: Early sleet blinded the watershed ridge above Ravenwatch, leaving scouts stranded in the pass. Haul pine-pitch barrels to relight the twin weather-cairns.

list: Reach loc-craghorn-saddle
Slay 4 Glasswings circling the ridge
Ignite both Craghorn Weather-Cairns

p: Freezing sleet snuffs out ordinary wood-fires on Craghorn Ridge within ten minutes. Pitch-soaked rags and oil jugs keep the warning cairns blazing so the valley knows when raiders cross.

title: Stakes on Alder Bluff
summary: Act I frontier side quest from Captain Garrick, offering gold and experience for planting sharpened stakes on Alder Bluff.

p: Quill Fiends nested in the white-clay gullies above Alder Bridge, sniping baggage mules from cover. Clear the ridge and plant sharpened ash stakes.

list: Slay 8 Quill Fiends at loc-alder-bluff
Place 4 Sharpened Ash Stakes along the embankment

p: Charging thorn-boars and pack rushers love the smooth slope above the river road. Hammering a row of fire-hardened ash stakes into the chalk turns their favorite ambush lane into a butcher's fence.

title: Green Slag Cullets
summary: Act I frontier side quest from Alchemist Marta, granting gold and experience for gathering fused furnace cullets.

p: Widow Marta needs chunks of vitrified green silica from the old quarry kilns to grind into eye-salve powder, though Flintbacks sleep among the cold furnaces.

list: Gather 6 Green Silica Slag Chunks from loc-vitrified-kilns
Defeat 3 Flintbacks guarding the slag heaps
Bring the slag chunks to Widow Marta

p: Around the vitrified kilns, melted bronze and sand cooled into dense green lumps that hum faintly in wet weather. Marta needs a clean sackful to test how the kilns were fired so hot.

title: Dog-Tags in the Turnip Rows
summary: Act I frontier side quest from Smith Hobb, rewarding gold and experience for recovering stamped levy tags.

p: After the Ashbrook skirmish, dozens of fallen militiamen were buried hastily in the south ditch with their stamped brass pay-disks. Recover the disks before Gloom Stags desecrate the cairns.

list: Drive off 3 Gloom Stags prowling loc-ashbrook-turnip-field
Collect 7 Stamped Brass Pay-Disks

p: Hobb stamped every northern recruit's iron neck-tag himself before they marched out to the turnip fields. Bringing the lost tags back lets families close their grief and lets Hobb cross names off his wall.

title: Bent Pikes of the Sunken Ford
summary: Act I frontier side quest from Smith Hobb, paying gold and experience for salvaging bent iron pike-heads.

p: Rootbound hulks snapped half the garrison's boar-spears during the last ford patrol. Recover the broken steel heads from the creek bed so Hobb can re-weld them.

list: Destroy 2 Rootbound lurking near loc-thornwick-weir
Salvage 6 Snapped Pike-Heads

p: Scrap iron is worth its weight in bread on the northern border, and the muddy banks of Sunken Ford are littered with snapped polearms. Haul the bent heads back so Hobb can hammer them straight.

title: Rawhide for the Jawbone Gate
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Warden Hale, awarding gold and experience for delivering rawhide lashing.

p: Dry desert winds split the rawhide lashings binding Redmarsh's leviathan-bone gate. Harvest tough Dune Beast hides to re-lash the timbers before the next dust squall.

list: Slay 4 Dune Beasts near loc-whale-rib-gate
Deliver 4 Thick Dune-Beast Hides to Warden Hale

p: Dry alkali wind shrinks and snaps the leather lashings holding Redmarsh's giant jawbone gate together. Freshly soaked rawhide strips tighten like iron hoops once they bake in the desert sun.

title: Ash from the East Blind
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Scholar Zahra, offering gold and experience for inspecting canyon sniper nests.

p: Sand-clan spotters etched caravan schedules and tribal clan-marks into the sandstone lintel of the East Jawbone Blind. Make charcoal rubbings before wind scours the stone.

list: Clear the Sand Raiders holding loc-jawbone-east-blind
Take 3 Charcoal Lintel Rubbings
Return the rubbings to Zahra

p: Desert hornbowmen leave behind charred signal-ash and notched range-sticks inside their cliffside blinds. Zahra wants samples from the eastern crag to determine who is supplying their powder and arrows.

title: Shattered Heliographs
summary: Act II frontier side quest from the Alkali Drover, rewarding gold and experience for salvaging broken heliographs.

p: Raider scouts use polished bronze mirrors hidden in the Bracken Hoodoo Maze to flash ambush signals across the basin. Smash the mirror stands.

list: Navigate loc-bracken-hoodoos and destroy 4 Bronze Heliograph Stands
Eliminate 6 Dune Lurkers nesting in the maze

p: Polished brass mirrors flash caravan warnings across ten miles of flat salt-pan in a single heartbeat. Raiders smashed the ridge stands, leaving valuable reflector plates scattered in the dust.

title: Unbroken Naphtha Jars
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Quartermaster Bram, paying gold and experience for securing intact naphtha jars.

p: Unexploded clay firepots from the Highgate assault still lie half-buried in the dry arroyo. Recover the intact jars before Storm Kites spark the brush.

list: Slay 5 Storm Kites above loc-highgate-creek
Recover 5 Intact Clay Firepots

p: Clay pots of desert fire-oil are nasty to carry in a bouncing saddlebag, yet nothing clears out a dune-lurker nest faster. Bram pays well for unbroken jars lifted from raider caches.

title: Leyden Horns of the Monolith
summary: Act II frontier side quest from the Wardstone Surveyor, granting gold and experience for recovering monolith fittings.

p: Dune Scarabs drawn to the Third Quartz Monolith have grown charged copper horns capable of grounding wild static. Harvest their forked horns for Surveyor Nira.

list: Kill 8 Dune Scarabs around loc-third-wardstone
Collect 6 Forked Copper Beetle-Horns

p: Flared copper horns bolted to the plateau obelisks bleed off excess storm-charge before the quartz cracks. Salvaging intact horns from the fractured spires keeps Redmarsh's remaining wards grounded.

title: Skimming the Milestone Well
summary: Act II frontier side quest from the Cistern Guard, awarding gold and experience for clearing fouled surface scum.

p: Maggot Swarms fouled the Bitter Milestone Well along the corduroy road, tainting the sole watering trough for ten leagues. Purge the larvae and drop quicklime bags.

list: Burn 4 Maggot Swarms around loc-third-milestone-well
Lower 3 Quicklime Purifying Sacks into the well

p: A thick, oily crust has settled over the milestone well, choking the buckets and sickening patrol mules. Skimming the taint while fending off thirsty desert beasts keeps the road passable.

title: The Assay-Vault Balances
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Water-Seller Tull, offering gold and experience for recovering assay balances.

p: Cask-Master Tull needs the precision brass balance-beams locked inside Redrock Canyon Vault to weigh salt-tax silver fairly, though Scale Vipers coil in the cool sandstone.

list: Slay 6 Scale Vipers inside loc-redrock-assay-vault
Recover the Brass Assay Balance-Set

p: In a town where silver buys water and clipped coin starts knife-fights, honest brass scales are priceless. Tull wants the precision balances rescued from the abandoned Redrock assay vault.

title: Bitumen from the Twelve Stones
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Alchemist Marta, rewarding gold and experience for scraping ritual bitumen.

p: Witch Doctors at the Twelve Megaliths boil marsh bitumen with willow-ash to coat hex-stones. Scrape three jars of the thick residue for Widow Marta's counter-salves.

list: Defeat 3 Witch Doctors at loc-megalith-hollow
Collect 3 Jars of Boiled Marsh-Bitumen

p: Around the Twelve Stones, desert hexers burned strange mineral tars that left a greasy black crust on the rock. Marta needs fresh scrapings to brew a counter-agent against bog-curses.

title: Iron Keys of the Third Terrace
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Miner Tomas, paying gold and experience for lifting overseer shackle keys.

p: Crypt Embalmers patrolling the Deep Quarry slave-pens still carry the heavy iron ward-keys to the lower tool-cribs. Recover the keys so Tomas's men can arm themselves.

list: Destroy 3 Crypt Embalmers in loc-quarry-third-terrace
Retrieve 3 Rusted Iron Tool-Crib Keys

p: Cold-chiseling iron collars off exhausted miners takes half an hour and risks a broken collarbone. Taking the heavy iron key-rings straight off the third terrace guards frees dozens in minutes.

title: Re-Carving the Crossroads
summary: Act II frontier side quest from Warden Hale, granting gold and experience for correcting defaced road markers.

p: With the decoy cairns gone, Crossroads Milestone still lacks legible league-marks for incoming relief columns. Escort a stone-cutter to re-chisel the four imperial glyphs.

list: Guard the mason at loc-four-faced-milestone against 2 waves of Sand Raiders
Verify all four directional glyphs are re-cut

p: Someone hammered the safe-water arrows backward at the crossroads to steer green patrols into alkali quicksand. Bringing stone-chisels out to recut the true bearings saves the next relief column.

title: Brine-Shield Pavises
summary: Act III frontier side quest from Shipwright Kors, awarding gold and experience for harvesting tough coastal shells.

p: Giant Salt Crabs on the Greywash flats grow meter-wide shields of calcified salt and oak planking. Harvest four intact claws for Kors's marine boarding parties.

list: Slay 6 Salt Crabs on loc-greywash-mudflats
Collect 4 Intact Brine-Shield Claws

p: Thick, curved crab shells boiled in vinegar and bolted to ash frames make surprisingly sturdy pavises for boarding crews. Kors pays good silver for unbroken carapaces hauled off the tide-flats.

title: Yellow Cakes from the Vents
summary: Act III frontier side quest from Healer Sera, offering gold and experience for collecting sulfur deposits.

p: Cinderlings nesting in the cliffside fumaroles hoard pure sulfur crusts that Chief Healer Sera burns to fumigate gangrene wards. Gather five sulfur cakes.

list: Kill 7 Cinderlings at loc-cinder-fumaroles
Gather 5 Pure Sulfur Crust Cakes

p: Burning yellow sulfur cakes in iron braziers keeps spore-matron clouds and biting marsh-flies out of the surgical tents. Sera needs fresh chunks pried from the smoking coastal vents.

title: Chains of the Split Tooth
summary: Act III frontier side quest from Warden Lyra, rewarding gold and experience for breaking coastal prisoner cages.

p: Privateers strung rusted gibbet-cages across the Split Tooth pass, rattling nerves and blocking supply wains. Cut down the cages and clear the Hollow Knights.

list: Defeat 4 Hollow Knights guarding loc-split-tooth-spire
Cut down 3 Rusted Gibbet-Cages

p: Raiders strung iron gibbet-cages along the Split Tooth crags to hold captured scouts and harbor pilots for ransom. Shattering the chains before the tide rises brings experienced hands back to Oakhaven.

title: Boiled Linen for the Nave
summary: Act III frontier side quest from the Oakhaven Surgeon, paying gold and experience for delivering boiled bandage linen.

p: Apothecary Linn's field hospital in the ruined chapel nave is out of clean bandaging cloth while Bog Dartblowers pick off stretcher-bearers in the bracken.

list: Slay 8 Bog Dartblowers outside loc-chapel-triage-nave
Deliver 4 Bales of Boiled Linen to Apothecary Linn

p: Clean, boiled cloth is rarer than gold plate inside the coastal chapel nave after three days of heavy skirmishing. Hauling fresh linen bales through the tree line keeps wounded veterans from losing limbs.

title: The Drowned Prism
summary: Harbor Pilot's Act III frontier quest offering 610 gold and 1060 XP to recover a drowned lighthouse prism.

p: Before the sea-fortress flooded, the Drowned Lighthouse housed a brass-mounted crystal prism capable of piercing coastal fog. Recover it from the Lantern Eels.

list: Kill 6 Lantern Eels inside loc-citadel-lighthouse
Retrieve the Brass-Mounted Lighthouse Prism

p: Without its faceted brass-bound lens, the Harborwatch beacon throws barely enough light to clear the breakwater. Pilots refuse to run overloaded caravels through the fog until someone dives into the flooded vaults and hauls the heavy glass back.

title: Tide-Stakes on the Spit
summary: Salt Corporal's Act III frontier quest paying 660 gold and 1150 XP to plant tide-stakes along the shingle spit.

p: Storm surges washed away the depth-markers along Hourglass Shingle Spit, trapping heavily armored pickets when the tide turns. Hammer new iron tide-gauges at low water.

list: Reach loc-shingle-spit and drive in 4 Iron Tide-Gauges
Defeat 3 Frost Bells haunting the surf

p: At dusk the narrow gravel bar disappears under two feet of gray chop, swallowing supply carts that stray ten paces off the crown. Hammering tarred marker-stakes into the wet stones before the swell rises saves both mules and boots.

title: Felling the Night Orchard
summary: Mudlark Pip's Act III frontier quest awarding 700 gold and 1220 XP for felling blighted coastal cider trees.

p: Animated gallows-trees on the High-Orchard Terraces bombard Oakhaven's timber crews with screaming skull-fruit. Burn the blighted trunks down to ash.

list: Destroy 4 Night Orchards in loc-cider-orchard
Collect 3 Charred Heartwood Cores

p: Pip has no love for orchards, especially ones that grab passersby by the collar and drop sour spores into the rain-barrels. Bring sharp axes, keep your back to the stone wall, and leave nothing standing taller than a knee.

title: Bronze Gears of Twin-Lock
summary: Riverlock Keeper's Act III frontier quest granting 730 gold and 1280 XP to recover bronze gears for Twin-Lock.

p: Lock-Keeper Orin needs heavy graphite grease-drums packed into the capstan pits before salt corrosion seizes the eastern floodgate ratchets.

list: Slay 5 Spore Matrons near loc-twin-lock-island
Apply 3 Graphite Grease-Drums to the capstan gears

p: Salt spray chews through ordinary iron teeth in a single winter, leaving the canal floodgates jammed half-open. The keeper needs cast bronze pinions salvaged from the lower shed before the freshwater basin drains into the sea.

title: The Baron's Smuggler Ledgers
summary: Warden Lyra's Act III frontier quest offering 765 gold and 1340 XP to seize Baron Vane's smuggling ledgers.

p: Baron Vane kept coded harbor-pilot bribes locked in an iron strongbox at the base of his catacomb lift. Recover the ledgers before Hollow Kings scatter the vault.

list: Defeat 2 Hollow Kings in loc-vane-catacomb-lift
Recover Baron Vane's Iron Strongbox

p: Lyra has suspected for months that Oakhaven's grain shortages were walking out the back gate on Vane's private barges. Bringing her the ironbound strongbox gives the garrison all the proof it needs to confiscate the Baron's stores.

title: Ramrods for the Culverin Wall
summary: Harbor Firewarden's Act III frontier quest paying 800 gold and 1400 XP to haul ramrods to the culverin wall.

p: Harborwatch's bronze coastal guns are fouling with black powder residue while Frosthorn Bruisers batter the seawall stairs. Deliver wet sheepskin sponge-rods to the gunners.

list: Slay 4 Frosthorn Bruisers on loc-harborwatch-seawall
Deliver 5 Sheepskin Culverin Sponge-Rods

p: Firing a hot bronze gun without swabbing the bore turns the crew into red mist on the next load. Raiders burned the forward tool-wagon, leaving the seawall gunners desperate for fresh sheepskin sponge-rods.

title: Razor-Glass of the Coves
summary: Ash-Scout's Act IV frontier quest awarding 860 gold and 1500 XP for harvesting sharp volcanic glass from the coves.

p: Redglass Drakes shedding wing-shards along the Obsidian Landing Coves leave razor-sharp volcanic glass capable of slicing demonic hide. Harvest intact wing-plates.

list: Slay 4 Redglass Drakes above loc-black-glass-coves
Collect 5 Intact Red-Obsidian Wing-Shards

p: Where magma met cold mountain runoff, the stone cooled into brittle black sheets sharper than any guild razor. Scouts lash slivers onto arrow-shafts and field knives that slice cleanly through thick leather.

title: Iron Chevaux-de-Frise
summary: Commander Rowan's Act IV frontier quest granting 920 gold and 1620 XP to plant iron obstacles along Highcrest.

p: Crowned Maws keep bounding over Highcrest Redoubt's shallow ash-trenches to maul wounded pickets. Anchor heavy iron-spiked barricades along the northern lip.

list: Eliminate 6 Crowned Maws around loc-highcrest-bluff
Anchor 4 Iron-Spiked Chevaux-de-Frise

p: Timber barricades catch fire the moment a cinderhorn breathes on them, so Rowan ordered heavy iron spikes bolted into crossed frames. Dragging them into the ash-drifts under sniper fire is ugly work, yet it breaks charges cold.

title: Grounding the West Spire
summary: Siege Sapper's Act IV frontier quest paying 1000 gold and 1750 XP to ground the crackling West Spire.

p: Residual lightning from the shattered West Focusing Crag arcs fatally into marching infantry. Bolt heavy copper grounding cables from the spire base into the ash.

list: Destroy 3 Stormtrees near loc-west-beacon-crag
Bolt 3 Heavy Copper Grounding Cables

p: Stray static arcing off the shattered beacon tower has already cooked two mules and melted a sergeant's helm-buckle. Pegging thick copper cables straight into the basalt drains the charge so sappers can approach safely.

title: Filling the Glacis Craters
summary: Greystone Sentry's Act IV frontier quest offering 1070 gold and 1880 XP to fill smoking craters on the glacis.

p: Molten catapult craters outside Greystone's east sally-port block cavalry sorties and hide burrowing Basalt Brutes. Clear the brutes and collapse the crater rims.

list: Defeat 3 Basalt Brutes outside loc-greystone-sallyport
Collapse 4 Slag-Crater Rims with sapper charges

p: Hostile mortar shells punched waist-deep pits right outside the sallyport, turning every counter-charge into a broken-ankle trap. Hauling gravel baskets out into the crossfire keeps the garrison's exit road passable.

title: Grimoires of the Summit Stair
summary: Penitent Elias's Act IV frontier quest awarding 1150 gold and 2000 XP to salvage grimoires from the summit stair.

p: Malrik's fleeing acolytes dropped three iron-clasped summoning grimoires on the Ashveil switchbacks. Recover the books before Rift Moths drain their wards.

list: Slay 6 Rift Moths along loc-ashveil-portal-stair
Recover 3 Iron-Clasped Ashveil Grimoires

p: When the renegade arcanists fled up Ashveil Gorge, half their pack-mules bolted and spilled bound folios across the smoking steps. Elias wants the surviving pages gathered before sulfur rain turns the ink to mud.

title: Billets from the Unquenched Jaw
summary: Foundry Stoker's Act IV frontier quest granting 1210 gold and 2120 XP to haul hot billets from the Unquenched Jaw.

p: Stoker Brann needs raw meteoric slag-billets cooled along the edges of the Unquenched Jaw fissure so Vok can re-forge shattered vanguard shields.

list: Defeat 2 Anvilmaw Smiths guarding loc-unquenched-jaw-trench
Collect 5 Meteoric Slag-Billets

p: High-grade caldera ironstone cools too brittle unless hauled straight from the pit while still glowing dull cherry. Tongs, thick leather aprons, and fast boots are the only things standing between a stoker and blistered ribs.

title: Jamming the Magnetic Narrows
summary: Commander Rowan's Act IV frontier quest paying 1280 gold and 2240 XP to jam the Magnetic Narrows gate.

p: Dread Knights hold the twin portcullis winches above Magnetic Iron Narrows, threatening to trap the vanguard mid-defile. Seize the gatehouses and wedge the chains.

list: Slay 4 Dread Knights in loc-magnetic-canyon
Wedge both Portcullis Winch-Chains

p: If the Iron Pact drops the middle iron grate behind our vanguard, the canyon turns into an iron coffin. Wedging stone blocks into the counterweight shafts keeps the road open until the last cart clears.

title: Chains Over the Magma Moat
summary: Siege Sapper's Act IV frontier quest offering 1340 gold and 2360 XP to free rusted chains over the magma moat.

p: Intense heat from the molten basalt river warped the six-inch iron links of the Citadel Drawbridge, while Cinderhorns guard the gatehouse murder-holes.

list: Defeat 3 Cinderhorns at loc-magma-moat-bridge
Cool and brace the 2 Main Drawbridge Windlasses

p: Volcanic grit welds iron links solid in three days flat unless kept slick with heavy mineral grease. Reaching the winch-house means crossing narrow stone ledges while hot updrafts singe your cloak.

title: Horns of Three-Roads Watch
summary: Commander Rowan's Act IV frontier quest awarding 1410 gold and 2480 XP to recover brass horns at Three-Roads Watch.

p: Ash Weavers spun incandescent fire-webs across the signal towers of Three-Roads Watch, cutting off communication with the flanking relief columns.

list: Eliminate 5 Ash Weavers at loc-three-roads-watch
Sound the 3 Brass Relay-Horns

p: Thick ash-fog swallows lantern light within twenty paces, leaving brass war-horns as the only reliable way to coordinate flanking columns. Rowan needs the garrison's long horns rescued from the overrun outer pickets.

title: Ash for the Anchor Seals
summary: Threshold Penitent's Act IV frontier quest granting 1500 gold and 2600 XP to bring consecrated ash to the seals.

p: Penitent Sola needs consecrated First-Watch ash scattered around the cooling Anchor Seals inside the Threshold Nave before final assault begins.

list: Clear 4 Silt Colossi guarding loc-threshold-nave
Anoint the 4 Cooling Anchor Seals

p: Even seasoned veterans feel their knees go weak near the ancient Anchor Seals where ley-pressure hums through the soles of their boots. Burning abbey ash in the bronze censers steadies the air and quiets restless wards.

title: Surveyor's Brass Theodolite
summary: Act I side quest in m07 from Surveyor Hal, rewarding 80 gold and 150 XP for recovering his brass theodolite.

p: Hal's frostbitten apprentice dropped three brass survey stakes and a sighting glass in the frozen gorges before the sentinels woke. Recover the kit so Thornwick can map the pass.

list: Recover the brass sighting glass in the west gorge
Collect both iron-shod survey stakes in the east defile
Return the survey kit before lighting the Twin Cairns

p: Hal dropped his prized sighting instrument in a freezing ditch when gnoll scouts broke out of the treeline. Without its graded brass rings, Thornwick's engineers are stuck guessing bridge spans by eye.

title: Locked Miners' Paychest
summary: Act I side quest in m10 from Foreman Durn, paying 110 gold and 180 XP to retrieve a locked miners' paychest.

p: Blood-cultists barricaded an old dwarven shift-office off the second gallery where three months of miners' silver still sits under a rune-bolt.

list: Take the rune-key off the cultist warden in gallery two
Unlock the dwarven shift-office door
Clear the cultists guarding the iron paychest

p: Dwarven drainage crews never leave silver behind willingly, which tells you how fast the undervault galleries flooded. The iron chest still sits chained to a stone pillar, waiting for someone tough enough to haul it dry.

title: Relief Valves on the Cliff
summary: Act III side quest in m25 from Well-Wright Maren, awarding 150 gold and 240 XP to open cliff relief valves.

p: Even after the ward-rings crack, trapped steam could burst Oakhaven's lower cistern pipes unless three bronze pressure valves are cranked open.

list: Open the western cliff relief valve
Crank the central cistern vent wheel
Release the eastern basalt pressure valve

p: Trapped steam beneath the coastal basalt is cracking Oakhaven's freshwater cisterns like eggshells. Turning the rusted bronze wheels along the cliff face vents the pressure before the whole terrace heaves.

title: Break the Signal Mirrors
summary: Act III side quest in m26 from Scout Captain Corin, offering 170 gold and 270 XP to smash enemy signal mirrors.

p: Hidden spotters perched along Split Tooth's flanks flash polished tin mirrors to guide arbalest volleys onto advancing infantry.

list: Smash the west ridge signal mirror
Clear the spotter perch above the coastal road
Shatter the east granite signal post

p: Renegade spotters perched on the moorland rocks flash range-codes straight down to their artillery crews. Shattering their polished brass reflectors blinds the guns and lets our infantry cross in one piece.

title: Salvage the Apothecary Cart
summary: Act III side quest in m27 from Surgeon Sera, granting 190 gold and 300 XP to salvage a stranded apothecary cart.

p: An overturned supply cart in the drizzle holds Sera's last crates of laudanum and clean linen bandages, right where raider hounds are prowling.

list: Fight through the hound pack in the south bracken
Recover the strapped laudanum crate
Haul the linen bandage bales back to the chapel

p: Amputating shattered limbs with nothing stronger than watered ale breaks even the toughest veteran's nerve. Sera needs the intact laudanum crates pulled out of the ditch before raiders smash the glass.

title: Drowned Chart-Room
summary: Act III side quest in m28 from Harbor Pilot Venn, paying 210 gold and 330 XP to loot a drowned chart-room.

p: Before the lower ward floods chin-deep, Pilot Venn wants the reef soundings locked inside the Sunken Citadel's sea-level chart-room.

list: Force the swollen oak door of the lower chart-room
Retrieve the oiled-leather reef charts
Escape the lower ward before the tide rises

p: Oilskin depth-charts showing every submerged reef outside Oakhaven still hang inside the Sunken Citadel's flooded tower. Grab them before salt water eats the ink, or the evacuation fleet sails blind.

title: Quivers on the Canyon Trail
summary: Act III side quest in m29 from Gate Warden Lyra, awarding 230 gold and 360 XP to gather quivers on the trail.

p: Lyra's relief runners were cut down along the canyon track, leaving three iron-bound bolt chests scattered behind the roadblocks.

list: Recover the bolt chest behind the first deadfall
Reclaim the quiver bundle near the canyon bend
Deliver the quarrels to Iron-Gate Watchtower

p: Retreating bowmen shed heavy war-quivers along the canyon switchbacks to outrun the rising tide. Good ash arrows with steel bodkins are too scarce to leave rotting in the shingle.

title: Cap the Hidden Spring
summary: Act III side quest in m30 from Sapper Tobb, offering 250 gold and 390 XP to cap a hidden orchard spring.

p: Even with their cisterns low, High-Orchard's garrison sneaks water-bearers down a wooded gully to an old stone springhouse after dark.

list: Clear the water-bearers guarding the gully
Collapse the springhouse culvert with a powder charge
Block the wooded path back to the redoubt

p: Besieging raiders have been watering their pack-mules at an unmarked spring tucked behind the stone terraces. Plugging the shaft with quicklime and rubble forces them to haul brine from the shore.

title: The Bridge-Warden's Ledger
summary: Act III side quest in m31 from Quartermaster Bram, granting 280 gold and 420 XP to seize the bridge-warden's ledger.

p: The riverlock's turncoat warden collected three seasons of bridge tolls in an iron chest bolted inside the western toll-booth.

list: Breach the western toll-booth iron door
Slay the turncoat toll-collector
Confiscate the bridge-warden's strongbox

p: Corrupt canal mercenaries skimmed silver off every grain barge entering Harborwatch for six straight months. Bram wants their toll-book back so the garrison can claw back every stolen florin.

title: Shatter the Anchor Pylons
summary: Act III side quest in m32 from Arcanist Orin, paying 310 gold and 450 XP to shatter ancient anchor pylons.

p: Three ancient rune-pylons along the pine ridge feed slow regeneration into the Elder Juggernaut's anthracite core.

list: Smash the west ridge binding pylon
Topple the moss-covered center rune-stone
Destroy the east cliff anchor pylon

p: Cracked stone obelisks ringing the highland cairn still leak erratic earth-charge into the awakened colossus. Knocking them flat cuts the titan off from the mountain's ley-veins.

title: Burn Vane's Debt Writs
summary: Act III side quest in m33 from Captain Mara, awarding 340 gold and 480 XP to burn Baron Vane's debt writs.

p: Baron Vane keeps a box of signed debt-writs in his study, holding dozens of coastal shipwrights hostage to his treason.

list: Force the door to Vane's upper manor study
Seize the iron-bound debt-writ coffer
Burn the writs in the manor hearth

p: Vane kept half Oakhaven's ship-captains compliant by threatening to foreclose on their families' dry-docks. Tossing his notarized parchments into a brazier buys more loyalty than a chest of crowns.

title: Reclaim the Stolen Cannon-Parts
summary: Act III side quest in m34 from Master Gunner Rolf, offering 370 gold and 510 XP to reclaim stolen cannon parts.

p: Among the harbor salvage the two mercenary bands are fighting over are three bronze trunnions meant for Oakhaven's seawall.

list: Secure the salvage crate on the northern mudbank
Recover the bronze trunnion from the eastern camp
Tag the third crate in the hollow for haulage

p: Rival mercenary companies stripped bronze trunnions and elevating screws off two disabled harbor guns during the confusion. Rolf wants his hardware back before the seawall takes another assault.

title: Save the Unfinished Brig
summary: Act III side quest in m35 from Shipwright Odo, granting 400 gold and 540 XP to save an unfinished evacuation brig.

p: A half-planked brig sits in Harborwatch's drydock as burning pitch-pots rain down; cutting its keel-chocks will slide it into safe water.

list: Clear the pitch-throwers on the drydock catwalk
Cut the port-side keel-chocks
Knock free the starboard launch wedges

p: Her hull is caulked and her mast is stepped, yet arsonists are closing in on the slipway chains. Freeing the drydock winches lets the tide float her clear before fire-pots turn her to ash.

title: Mark Safe Paths in the Ash
summary: Act IV side quest in m36 from Pathfinder Joren, paying 430 gold and 570 XP to mark safe trails in the ash.

p: Sulfur crust hides boiling steam vents across the black glass sand; planting iron trail-poles will save the main baggage train.

list: Plant a marker pole past the western sulfur sink
Drive a stake along the central glass ridge
Set the final trail-marker below Highcrest bluff

p: Fresh cinder-snow buries old wagon ruts in an hour, hiding deep thermal cracks beneath a smooth gray crust. Stacking painted basalt cairns along the firm spine keeps the main column from losing horses.

title: Salvage the Copper Conductors
summary: Act IV side quest in m37 from Artificer Kel, awarding 460 gold and 600 XP to salvage copper conductors.

p: Heavy copper grounding rods driven beside each crag beacon can be pried loose to shield our sappers against static traps ahead.

list: Pry the copper rod from the west beacon crag
Recover the grounding spike on the north ridge
Collect the third copper conductor by the east prism

p: Pure annealed copper is harder to find in the highlands than gold plate, and the shattered signal beacons are full of it. Pry the heavy rods loose while the towers are still smoking.

title: Haul Quicklime to the Breach
summary: Act IV side quest in m38 from Mason-Sergeant Vane, offering 490 gold and 640 XP to haul quicklime to the breach.

p: Greystone's curtain wall is crumbling to gravel; hauling three barrels of quicklime-grout to the parapet will keep the gate-arch standing.

list: Roll the first grout barrel up the west stair
Deliver quicklime to the cracked center parapet
Reinforce the eastern gatehouse arch

p: Greystone's curtain wall is trembling under stonebreaker hits, and dry stone stacked without mortar topples at the first shove. Rolling heavy lime barrels up the ramp keeps the battlements standing.

title: Malrik's Scattered Folios
summary: Act IV side quest in m39 from Archivist Selene, granting 520 gold and 680 XP to gather Malrik's scattered folios.

p: Running blind up Ashveil Gorge, Malrik shed three lead-cased leyline folios behind his jagged obsidian barricades.

list: Recover the folio behind the lower obsidian wall
Reclaim the lead case in the middle gorge
Collect the third codex near the portal stairs

p: As Malrik sprinted toward the summit portal, loose vellum sheets tore free of his satchel and blew into the rocks. Selene wants every diagram recovered before enemy scouts burn the evidence.

title: Flood the Ley-Salt Magazines
summary: Act IV side quest in m40 from Sapper Captain Dax, paying 550 gold and 720 XP to flood enemy ley-salt magazines.

p: Even after the mana-cannons are spiked, their underground ley-salt magazines could detonate and collapse the citadel causeway.

list: Douse the ley-salt casks under the west crag
Ruin the powder-salt stores in the east bunker
Collapse the magazine vent shaft

p: Barrels of crystalline ley-salt feed the Iron Pact's heavy mana-cannons across the twin crags. Cracking the cistern pipes into their storage cellars turns lethal ordnance into harmless wet slush.

title: Extract the Lodestone Cores
summary: Act IV side quest in m41 from Smith-Master Tor, awarding 580 gold and 760 XP to extract lodestone cores.

p: The animated iron golems patrolling the canyon carry fist-sized lodestone cores that can demagnetize our vanguard's blades.

list: Pry the core from the first gate's iron golem
Recover the lodestone heart in the canyon narrows
Claim the third core before the final portcullis

p: Inside every fallen basalt brute sits a fist-sized heart of dense magnetic ore worth a fortune at the anvil. Tor pays handsomely for intact cores pried out of the canyon wreckage.

title: Choke the Magma Feeders
summary: Act IV side quest in m42 from Engineer Hollis, offering 610 gold and 800 XP to choke the magma feeders.

p: Two basalt sluice-gates feed fresh molten rock into the Citadel moat; dropping their iron portcullises will cool the crossing.

list: Drop the western magma feeder gate
Jam the eastern slag-channel shutter
Clear the fire-tenders guarding the moat wall

p: Iron Pact defenders flood the outer moat trenches with fresh molten slag whenever our sappers bring up ladders. Dropping the iron sluice-gates starves the channels until they crust over hard enough to cross.

title: Cut the Relief Signal Flags
summary: Act IV side quest in m43 from Captain Mara, granting 640 gold and 840 XP to cut hostile relief signal flags.

p: Three ash-plain watch-towers coordinate the converging relief armies with colored smoke pots; blinding them buys precious time.

list: Topple the northern signal scaffold
Smash the western smoke-pot brazier
Burn the eastern relay tower

p: Three wooden flag-masts overlooking the junction coordinate enemy reserve marches across the valley. Hacking down their halyards leaves the besieging columns stumbling blind in the smoke.

title: Read the Threshold Steles
summary: Act IV side quest in m44 from Archivist Selene, paying 660 gold and 860 XP to inspect the Threshold steles.

p: Four obsidian steles ring the geometric nave, recording the true price paid by the last ruler who walked through either colossal door.

list: Transcribe the silver-star stele on the west wall
Inspect the liquid-fire tablet on the east plinth
Read the central oath-stone behind the praetor line

p: Tall slate slabs lining the inner chamber record the exact terms of the ancient balance between stone and fire. Reading every face before stepping onto an altar ensures you know what you are signing.

title: Steady the Marble Resonators
summary: Act IV side quest in m45 from Arcanist Orin, awarding 680 gold and 880 XP to steady the marble resonators.

p: Three cracked marble chimes beneath the vault dome stabilize the leyline alignment so the Crown of Order doesn't shatter the altar.

list: Clear shadow praetorians from the north chime
Bind the cracked west resonator with silver wire
Strike the south chime as the leylines align

p: Cracked tuning pillars along the Crown Vault's flank are throwing wild stasis pulses that freeze friend and foe alike. Wedging copper shims into their bases calms the room long enough to fight cleanly.

title: Smother the Oath-Braziers
summary: Act IV side quest in m46 from Sapper Captain Dax, offering 700 gold and 900 XP to smother the oath-braziers.

p: Four iron oath-braziers around the Obsidian Throne vent fresh sulfur gas into the chamber, feeding Ashkarath's flames.

list: Tip the northwest sulfur brazier into the trench
Smother the northeast gas vent with slag-sand
Cap both southern throne-room braziers

p: Four towering iron bowls burning volcanic pitch feed the ambient heat inside the Furnace Heart. Dumping ash-sacks over their grates knocks the temperature down before your armor starts glowing.

title: Fenwick's Eel-Weir
summary: Rotting wicker fish-traps wedged between mossy oak pilings below the Sunken Ford.

p: Rotting wicker fish-traps wedged between mossy oak pilings below the Sunken Ford.
Broken courier tubes and gnoll shields bob against the weir stakes.

title: Old Border Mint
summary: Charred stone assay-house where Salt-Tithe clerks once stamped brass tax-tokens.

p: Charred stone assay-house where Salt-Tithe clerks once stamped brass tax-tokens.
Cold ash fills the smelting crucibles; stamped lead seals litter the cobbles.

title: Drowned Willow Sink
summary: Knee-deep black peat hollow choked with weeping willows and bobbing marsh-gas.

p: Knee-deep black peat hollow choked with weeping willows and bobbing marsh-gas.
Pale green lanterns drift ten paces ahead, luring boots off the boardwalk.

title: Ravenwatch Guard-Cellar
summary: Drafty stone basement beneath the signal tower, stacked with moldering levy-mail.

p: Drafty stone basement beneath the signal tower, stacked with moldering levy-mail.
A hidden trapdoor behind the wine racks leads down into older masonry.

title: Third Lantern Post
summary: Iron-caged oil beacon bolted into sheer limestone halfway up Lantern Passage.

p: Iron-caged oil beacon bolted into sheer limestone halfway up Lantern Passage.
The wick sputters blue in dead calm, throwing lunging claw-shadows on the slate.

title: Greywood Water-Mill
summary: Jammed timber sawmill choked with wet sawdust and overturned supply wagons.

p: Jammed timber sawmill choked with wet sawdust and overturned supply wagons.
Rusted haulage chains swing silently from the crane boom above.

title: Craghorn Watershed Saddle
summary: Wind-scoured granite ridge dividing two ice-shadowed alpine defiles.

p: Wind-scoured granite ridge dividing two ice-shadowed alpine defiles.
Two ancient weather-cairns stand cold and unlit against driving sleet.

title: Alder Chalk Bluff
summary: Steep white-clay embankment overlooking the sole wagon bridge across the Alder.

p: Steep white-clay embankment overlooking the sole wagon bridge across the Alder.
Broken arrow-shafts bristle from the turf like dead winter grass.

title: Old Quarry Glass-Kilns
summary: Abandoned stone furnaces fused inside with translucent green silica slag.

p: Abandoned stone furnaces fused inside with translucent green silica slag.
Heavy tusk-gouges score the birch trunks ringing the slag heaps.

title: Ashbrook South Ditch
summary: Muddy drainage trench outside the burned manor walls, lined with fresh cairns.

p: Muddy drainage trench outside the burned manor walls, lined with fresh cairns.
Splintered siege-rams lie half-buried in trampled turnip rows.

title: Whale-Rib Stockade Gate
summary: Sun-bleached leviathan jawbones lashed with rawhide above Redmarsh's mud moat.

p: Sun-bleached leviathan jawbones lashed with rawhide above Redmarsh's mud moat.
Alkali dust cakes every timber; sentries squint through green-tinted glass.

title: East Jawbone Sniper-Blind
summary: Slotted sandstone bunker perched eighty feet above the eastern caravan notch.

p: Slotted sandstone bunker perched eighty feet above the eastern caravan notch.
Charcoal tally-marks cover the lintel, counting every taxed water-skin.

title: Bracken Hoodoo Maze
summary: Labyrinth of wind-carved red pillars and thorny scrub prone to blinding haboobs.

p: Labyrinth of wind-carved red pillars and thorny scrub prone to blinding haboobs.
Signal mirrors flash sporadically from isolated boulder rings in the grit.

title: Highgate Dry Arroyo
summary: Cracked clay streambed winding directly beneath Highgate Watch's timber catwalks.

p: Cracked clay streambed winding directly beneath Highgate Watch's timber catwalks.
Shattered clay firepots and charred scaling ladders litter the gully.

title: Third Quartz Monolith
summary: Thirty-foot spire of primeval crystal split down its core by crimson blood-wards.

p: Thirty-foot spire of primeval crystal split down its core by crimson blood-wards.
Static crackles off iron helms; flattened grass forms a dead ring around it.

title: The Bitter Milestone Well
summary: Covered limestone trough beside the sunken corduroy road across the salt-pan.

p: Covered limestone trough beside the sunken corduroy road across the salt-pan.
Thick green scum and dead beetles float atop the stagnant brine.

title: Redrock Canyon Vault
summary: Vaulted sandstone cellar hidden behind a narrow slot canyon in the dry hills.

p: Vaulted sandstone cellar hidden behind a narrow slot canyon in the dry hills.
Burst grain sacks spill golden wheat across scorched silver-scales.

title: The Twelve Megaliths
summary: Sunken willow ring of black standing stones weeping bile-green miasma.

p: Sunken willow ring of black standing stones weeping bile-green miasma.
Bone chimes clack in still air around bubbling clay cauldrons.

title: Deep Quarry Slave-Pens
summary: Chained timber cages bolted into black ironstone ledges above a flooded pit.

p: Chained timber cages bolted into black ironstone ledges above a flooded pit.
Broken shackles and discarded quarry-picks rattle in the updraft.

title: Crossroads Milestone
summary: Weathered obelisk carved with four imperial distances at the junction of desert tracks.

p: Weathered obelisk carved with four imperial distances at the junction of desert tracks.
Chiseled-out glyphs and decoy rock-cairns point toward alkali sinkholes.

title: Greywash Tidal Flats
summary: Sucking black silt banks exposed twice daily between Oakhaven's piers and the reef.

p: Sucking black silt banks exposed twice daily between Oakhaven's piers and the reef.
Grounded ironclad pontoons tilt crookedly in the kelp.

title: Cliffside Cinder Vents
summary: Steaming basalt fissures above Oakhaven where ground sand fused into black glass.

p: Steaming basalt fissures above Oakhaven where ground sand fused into black glass.
Sulfur fumes blister exposed skin while cracked ward-pillars cool.

title: The Split Tooth Crag
summary: Razor-backed granite needle dividing the coastal road between twin arbalest forts.

p: Razor-backed granite needle dividing the coastal road between twin arbalest forts.
Rusted iron cages sway from chains beneath the customs semaphore.

title: Ruined Chapel Nave
summary: Roofless stone abbey sheltering canvas hospital tents behind rain-slick walls.

p: Roofless stone abbey sheltering canvas hospital tents behind rain-slick walls.
Lanterns glow through vinegar-stained canvas as hounds howl in the bracken.

title: Drowned Lighthouse Stair
summary: Tilted spiral stair climbing above a half-submerged First-Empire sea-fortress.
